themes.title: Government Economic Intervention & Sectoral Impact
themes.blurb: Right-wing news in the US and Norway highlights government economic policies and their diverse impacts on specific sectors and citizens. In Norway, coverage focuses on national fees threatening the fishing industry and interest rate hikes pushing families toward welfare assistance. In the US, discussions revolve around the Trump administration's cancellation of offshore wind leases, a proposed diesel export ban to manage energy prices, and broader trade policies.
